introduction: NC Medicaid provides health coverage for eligible residents. ePASS calls the program Medical Assistance.
description: NC Medicaid provides health coverage for eligible residents. ePASS calls the program Medical Assistance.

sections.who: Income, age, household and care needs affect eligibility. Older, blind, disabled or long-term-care applicants may need additional forms.
sections.get: Approved coverage helps pay eligible health-care costs. Read the notice for coverage and enrollment instructions.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use Medicaid application guidance: ePASS, county DSS or HealthCare.gov.

  2. Identify your needs

    Tell DSS about disability, older-age or long-term-care circumstances.

  3. Respond to requests

    Check mail and account notices and send proof.
sections.after: Keep contact information current and complete renewal steps.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using NC Medicaid application routes; Eligibility. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
